concept: DynamoDB: strongly consistent reads for read-after-write
tests: Knowing when a strongly consistent read is needed to see a just-completed write immediately.
expected: ConsistentRead=true (strongly consistent read). Triggers: "read immediately after the write", "balance must always reflect the latest write", "stale is unacceptable".
why_not: Eventually consistent may return the value before the debit; a global table replica in another Region updates asynchronously; DAX without write-through may return a stale balance.
